verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is a SaaS platform that processes customer data and ships AI features (AI Runs, AgentControl configs, LLM tracking), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a policy or control that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. Adjacent compliance evidence such as the FedRAMP-compliant federal instance does not address AI training, so it earns no credit.
